description: Header file defining the SpdifStreamOut class, which implements an SPDIF audio stream output for Android, wrapping encoded data in SPDIF format and interfacing with AudioFlinger.

classes.name: SpdifStreamOut
classes.description: A class that manages SPDIF stream output, wrapping encoded PCM data in SPDIF format for Android's audio system.

methods.name: SpdifStreamOut
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SPDIF stream with device, flags, and format.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the SPDIF stream with specified handle, devices, configuration, and address.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the SPDIF stream.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a frame in bytes.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns the audio format of the stream.

methods.name: getSampleRate
methods.description: Returns the sample rate of the stream.

methods.name: getChannelMask
methods.description: Returns the channel mask of the stream.

methods.name: standby
methods.description: Puts the stream into standby mode.

methods.name: writeDataBurst
methods.description: Writes a burst of data to the SPDIF encoder.
